headline: Enhance CodeClip with AI-Powered Features
summary: Integrate AI to automatically categorize and tag code snippets, and use machine learning models for personalized recommendations based on user behavior. Implement real-time collaboration features using websockets to allow developers to share and discuss code snippets in real time.
